description: Intents for contact forms, escalations, and agent requests. Enables users to submit contact information for follow-up.

intents.name: contact_agent
phrases: i want to contact an agent
i need to speak with someone
i'd like to speak with an agent
i want to leave my contact info
can you have someone call me
i want to talk to handoff specialist
intents.response: I'd be happy to help you connect with our team. To better assist you, could you please provide your name, email address, and let me know what you'd like to discuss? I'll make sure someone from our team reaches out to you shortly.

params.follow_up_message: Thank you for reaching out! We've received your request and someone from our team will contact you shortly.

intents.name: urgent_escalation
intents.response: I understand this is urgent. I'm connecting you with our priority support team right now. Could you briefly describe the issue so we can help you faster?

intents.name: feedback_submission
phrases: i want to report an issue
intents.response: We appreciate your feedback! It helps us improve. Could you tell us more about what's on your mind? This will help our team better understand your needs.
